facts.fact_text: The applicants complained of disproportionate measures taken against them as organisers or participants of country-wide protests against a retirement age hike.
The country-wide protests against the retirement age hike were organised by Aleksey Navalnyy.
The country-wide protests against the retirement age hike organised by Aleksey Navalnyy took place on 9 September 2018.
